rationale: No git-history precedent supports a two-commit coexistence split for this cross-file, single-dispatch-point cutover; ENH-3611's two-commit safety mechanism (same-file shared idempotent gate) does not transfer, no FSM-level gating primitive exists, and the codebase already has a documented double-counting hazard for this class of transitional risk.
rule: Single atomic commit for Phase B (Option A)
alternatives_rejected: Option B: two-commit split mirroring ENH-3611 (additive coexistence commit, then subtractive cutover commit)
